newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - March 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - March 13.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Thursday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Government panel proposes privatisation of postal service.
-- Itochu Corp and other major firms plan to introduce new recruitment systems under holding company.
-- Mexican President Ernesto Zedillo seeks wider free trade pacts.
-- North Korean defector to stop in Singapore before going to Seoul.
-- Prosecutors say former Health Ministry bureaucrat failed to replace unheated blood products to avoid blame.
-- Further radioactive pollution feared due to failure to seal off danger area.
-- Balance of personal savings at end of December totalled more than 1,000 trillion yen.
